name: B1 Church
shortDescription: A free church system with an app, website builder, people records, giving, check-in, forms and groups. It can also set up repeatable steps for church tasks.
suitableContexts: Churches seeking a single free platform for app, website and administration
Teams able to test a newer free provider thoroughly

pricing.summary: B1 Church states that every feature is $0 per month, with no tiers, trials, per-member pricing or added transaction fees. Check the live availability and ask for the terms of payment-related services before adopting them.

tiers.label: B1 Church
tiers.detail: Supplier says all features are free forever, at every church size

editorial.assessment: B1 Church is unusually ambitious for a free platform, bundling public, member and administration tools. The absence of subscription cost makes a controlled trial attractive, but it also makes due diligence around support, payment processing, data handling and business continuity especially important.
bestFor: Churches wanting to pilot an all-in-one platform without a software budget
Teams willing to check free-service limits and migration options before changing systems
strengths: Supplier publishes a no-tier, no-per-member free model
Broad app, website, people, forms and workflow coverage
limitations: Ask the supplier about UK payment, Gift Aid and data-processing fit
A free model still needs a clear support and exit plan

procurementVerdict.problem: Churches wanting to pilot an all-in-one platform without a software budget
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Ask the supplier about UK payment, Gift Aid and data-processing fit

longForm.verdict: B1 Church is worth a controlled pilot where an all-in-one platform is attractive but budget is constrained. The question is whether the church can validate the operational guarantees it needs before making free software its central system.

decisionLens.heading: Free forever needs an exit plan as well as an entry plan.
decisionLens.text: The supplier says there are no tiers or per-member charges. Before importing live records, clarify exports, support response, payment-provider responsibilities, domain ownership and how the church would recover its data if its needs changed.

sections.heading: A broad free platform
sections.question: Can it replace enough separate tools safely?
paragraphs: B1 Church describes a member app, website builder, online giving, child check-in, member records, groups, workflows and multi-campus tools. It also lists a number of third-party integrations.

Set up a test church and complete the tasks that matter: form approval, volunteer permissions, a website update, a donation record and an export. Do not infer that payment or Gift Aid workflows meet UK needs without current supplier documentation for those workflows.

userFeedback.summary: This profile does not use an independent review score. It is based on B1 Church’s official product, pricing and support pages.
themes: The free all-in-one offer makes a realistic evaluation possible.
Payment, support and exit arrangements matter more than headline subscription price.
userFeedback.caveat: Supplier feature claims are not independent testing or evidence of UK suitability.

faq.question: Is B1 Church free?
faq.answer: Yes. B1 Church says its platform is $0 per month with no tiers, trials or per-member pricing.

faq.question: Does B1 Church offer a trial?
faq.answer: No trial is needed according to the supplier because the full platform is free to start.

faq.question: Does B1 Church support UK Gift Aid?
faq.answer: Ask the supplier to demonstrate donation processing, declarations, reporting and reconciliation directly.
